<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a single series chain from A to B with intermediate taps. The cumulative resistances from A match 5 Ω, 15 Ω, 30 Ω, 60 Ω, 75 Ω, 105 Ω, 120 Ω, and 140 Ω at nodes N_a1, N_a2, N_a3, N_b1, N_b2, N_c1, N_c2, and B respectively. This yields resistor values R1=5 Ω, R2=10 Ω, R3=15 Ω, R4=30 Ω, R5=15 Ω, R6=30 Ω, R7=15 Ω, R8=20 Ω. Nodes X1 and X2 are located inside R4 and R6, splitting them into R4a=20 Ω, R4b=10 Ω and R6a=20 Ω, R6b=10 Ω. This topology reproduces every given node‑to‑node resistance.</thought>
